description: Specification for the matched R0 baseline training recipe reconstructed from the historical all-27 source training standard.

input_specification.tensor_arrangement: paired_tensors (xA: pre_sar of shape (B, 2, 224, 224), xB: post_sar of shape (B, 2, 224, 224))

preprocessing.stored_representation: Sentinel-1 GRD linear amplitude backscatter (square root of intensity)

label_and_mask_semantics.sensory_mask: MK0_MNA (1 = valid satellite coverage, 0 = no coverage)
label_and_mask_semantics.inputs_isolation: Labels and valid masks are strictly excluded from model forward pass inputs.

loss.name: ControlledSourceLoss
loss.formula: 0.5 * CrossEntropyLoss(logits, target, ignore_index=3) + 0.5 * SoftDiceLoss(softmax(logits), target, classes=[0,1,2], ignore_index=3, eps=1.0)

reproducibility.checkpoint_policy: save_every_epoch, final_checkpoint at epoch 16, no early stopping or validation selection
reproducibility.resume_support: atomic model, optimizer, epoch, step restoration

unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.fold_specific_r0_value: Exactly 18 training events per fold (14,967 patches for Fold C discovery; 13,302 patches for Fold A confirmation; 14,655 patches for Fold B confirmation)
unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.justification: Required to enforce strict event-disjoint cross-validation without label leakage to the 9 held-out evaluation events.

unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.historical_all27_value: 671 optimizer steps per epoch (21,462 patches / 32 effective batch size)
unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.fold_specific_r0_value: Fold C (A+B): 468 steps/epoch; Fold A (B+C): 416 steps/epoch; Fold B (A+C): 458 steps/epoch
unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.justification: Direct consequence of restricting the training partition to 18 events while keeping effective batch size fixed at 32.

unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.historical_all27_value: No validation or evaluation during source training
unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.fold_specific_r0_value: Post-training evaluation strictly on the 9 held-out events of the designated fold (Group C for discovery; Group A or B for confirmation)
unavoidable_differences_for_fold_specifi.justification: Enables rigorous event-macro flood F1 measurement on held-out events.
